description: Land Acquisition - Kapuwatta, Dambulla D/S Division. Matale District and an Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 2139/15 of 02.09.2019
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the government's intention to acquire multiple land parcels and servitudes for public purpose, providing detailed descriptions of each lot including location, extent, land type, and claimants. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters.
